maddeler.e:
استذكرن (form X)
# اِسْتَذْكَرْنَ (istaḏkarna) /is.tað.kar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
# اُسْتُذْكِرْنَ (ustuḏkirna) /us.tuð.kir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
# اِسْتَذْكِرْنَ (istaḏkirna) /is.tað.kir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
